llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: Local media, transcript, subtitle, and screenshot outputs are explicitly disclosed in the artifacts and are necessary for the skill's video-analysis purpose; this is a privacy/cleanup guidance issue rather than hidden behavior.
[SQP-2] expected: The transcript summarization path is user-directed: the script reads the specified transcript and prints a prompt plus an optional AI command, with no automatic external transmission.
llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with downloaded media, transcripts, subtitles, and screenshots being stored locally. Use a dedicated output directory, clean it up after analysis, and do not paste or pipe transcripts into an external AI tool unless you have permission to process that content and understand where it will go.
llm.summary: This skill does what it says: it downloads a user-provided video, creates local transcripts/screenshots, and offers a user-directed summarization helper.
